subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `/models test-fallback` command, fold fallback-chain testing into `openclaw models status --probe --all`, or treat it as part of staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent command surface overlaps existing auth probes and open model diagnostics or migration requests, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused slash/CLI fallback-chain probe that intentionally starts at configured fallback candidates and reports the responding model.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Make broad configured-model health checking own this behavior and expose `/models` only as a wrapper if maintainers want chat discoverability.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Scope fallback testing as part of the staged model migration flow instead of adding a standalone command now.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused slash/CLI fallback-chain probe that intentionally starts at configured fallback candidates and reports the responding model.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the clearest issue guidance and has direct history on the overlapping model-status probe surface.
